findings.summary: role="menu" on account/notification panels (also notification-bell.tsx:74) with plain <Link>/<button> children and no menuitem roles, roving tabindex, or arrow-key nav — an incomplete ARIA menu widget. Round 1's own debugger tried adding role="menuitem" and it broke getByRole locators by overriding native link/button roles. Recommendation for next round: drop role="menu"/aria-haspopup="menu" entirely (plain aria-label on the popover, no menu semantics) rather than complete the widget — a screen reader that announces "menu" but gets no arrow-key navigation is worse than no menu role at all, and this codebase already has the correct full pattern to imitate if a real menu is wanted later (language-selector.tsx's role="listbox"/role="option"/ArrowUp/ArrowDown at :153-180).

getPageContext() calls supabase.auth.getUser() a second time per request, after proxy.ts's middleware (lib/supabase/update-session.ts:43) already called it once for token refresh — an extra round trip to the Supabase auth server on every request to a homepage that is otherwise public. Deliberately left unchanged this round; it mirrors the pre-existing /todo pattern exactly, so it's not a regression this feature introduced. Defensible to defer since a real fix (request-scoped memoization, e.g. React cache()) is an app-wide auth-plumbing change, not a homepage-scoped one.

4.47MB source PNG, not recompressed. next/image re-encodes per requested size/format at request time so browser payload is bounded, but the origin file still bloats the repo and the build's image-optimization cache. Acceptable to defer since it is the design's own export and no smaller source exists without re-exporting from Figma.
